purpose: Human/curator decisions for Puzzleability v0 exceptions after direct visual inspection. Overrides analyzer review flags without changing objective metrics.

decisions.rationale: Technical ceiling-lamp drawing leaves most of the frame as nearly blank paper; too few distributed visual anchors for a satisfying jigsaw.
Three tiny flower-shaped necklace elements occupy a very small portion of a large uniform background.
A long rifle is isolated against a broad uniform studio background; most pieces would be background-only.
Extremely low-contrast monochrome landscape study has weak location cues across large areas even at low piece counts.
Single terracotta animal figure sits on a broad uniform studio backdrop; usable only at very low piece counts and not strong enough for the core catalog.
Dark negative space is substantial, but the central flowers and fern silhouettes provide strong, recognizable anchors for a low-piece-count puzzle.
Pale field is offset by calligraphy, seals, stems, blossoms, and the green lower band, giving enough distributed anchors for Relaxed.
Monochrome portrait is subtle, but face, clothing linework, hands, and border create stable location cues at a relaxed piece count.
Muted landscape remains playable because trees, blue architectural forms, terrain, and frame edges distribute recognizable structure.
Dense ornamental print is visually repetitive but highly structured; central figure, border, symmetry, text, and motifs make it a good challenging Standard puzzle.
